H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H7747: a Shuchite or descendant of Shuach
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H575: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither
H7760: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)
H4405: a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic
H995: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
H310: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H929: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
H2933: to be impure in a religious sense
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H2963: to pluck off or pull to pieces; causatively to supply with food (as in morsels)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H639: properly, the nose or nostril; hence, the face, and occasionally a person; also (from the rapid breathing in passion) ire
H4616: properly, heed, i.e. purpose; used only adverbially, on account of (as a motive or an aim), teleologically, in order that
H5800: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H6275: to remove (intransitive or transitive) figuratively, to grow old; specifically, to transcribe
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H4725: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H1846: to be extinguished; figuratively, to expire or be dried up
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H2821: to be dark (as withholding light); transitively, to darken
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H5216: a lamp (i.e. the burner) or light (literally or figuratively)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H3334: to press (intransitive), i.e. be narrow; figuratively, be in distress
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)
H6098: advice; by implication, plan; also prudence
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H7272: a foot (as used in walking); by implication, a step; by euphemistically the pudenda
H7639: a net-work, i.e. (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to apillar
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H6119: a heel (as protuberant); hence, a track; figuratively, the rear (of an army)
H6341: a (metallic) sheet (as pounded thin); also a spring net (as spread out like a lamina)
H2388: to fasten upon; hence, to seize, be strong (figuratively, courageous, causatively strengthen, cure, help, repair, fortify), obstinate; to bind, restrain, conquer
H2256: a rope (as twisted), especially a measuring line; by implication, a district or inheritance (as measured); or a noose (as of cords); figuratively, a company (as if tied together); also a throe (especially of parturition); also ruin
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H6327: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H6763: a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring)
H905: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
H5785: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather
H4194: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin
H4009: properly, a refuge, i.e. (objective) security, or (subjective) assurance
H6805: to pace, i.e. step regularly; (upward) to mount; (along) to march; (down and causatively) to hurl
H7931: to reside or permanently stay (literally or figuratively)
H1097: properly, failure, i.e. nothing or destruction; usually (with preposition) without, not yet, because not, as long as, etc.
H2219: to toss about; by implication, to diffuse, winnow
H5116: (adjectively) at home; hence (by implication of satisfaction) lovely; also (noun) a home, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (den)
H1614: properly, cypress-resin; by analogy, sulphur (as equally inflammable)
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H3001: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
H4605: properly, the upper part, used only adverbially with prefix upward, above, overhead, from the top, etc.
H7105: severed, i.e. harvest (as reaped), the crop, the time, the reaper, or figuratively; also a limb (of a tree, or simply foliage)
H2143: a memento, abstractly recollection (rarely if ever); by implication, commemoration
H6: properly, to wander away, i.e. lose oneself; by implication to perish (causative, destroy)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H2351: properly, separate by awall, i.e. outside, outdoors
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H2822: the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness
H8398: the earth (as moist and therefore inhabited); by extension, the globe; by implication, its inhabitants; specifically, a particular land, as Babylonia, Palestine
H5074: properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove, flee, or (causatively) to drive away
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H4033: a temporary abode; by extension, a permanent residence
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H8074: to stun (or intransitively, grow numb), i.e. devastate or (figuratively) stupefy (both usually in a passive sense)
H314: hinder; generally, late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H4908: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
